senses.definition_en: interminable

examples.english: He commended, however, the author's way of ending his book with the promise of that interminable adventure, and many a time was he tempted to take up his pen and finish it properly as is there proposed, which no doubt he would have done, and made a successful piece of work of it too, had not greater and more absorbing thoughts prevented him.
examples.ref: 1605, Miguel de Cervantes, chapter I, in El ingenioso hidalgo Don Quijote de la Mancha [ The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha], Primera parte, Madrid: Imprenta de Juan de la Cuesta:
examples.text: Pero, con todo, alababa en su autor aquel acabar su libro con la promesa de aquella inacabable aventura, y muchas veces le vino deseo de tomar la pluma y dalle fin al pie de la letra como allí se promete; y sin duda alguna lo hiciera, y aun saliera con ello, si otros mayores y continuos pensamientos no se lo estorbaran.
examples.translation: He commended, however, the author's way of ending his book with the promise of that interminable adventure, and many a time was he tempted to take up his pen and finish it properly as is there proposed, which no doubt he would have done, and made a successful piece of work of it too, had not greater and more absorbing thoughts prevented him.

glosses: interminable

senses.definition_en: applaudable; praiseworthy

examples.english: Therefore, although it is applaudable that President Duque intends to govern without a rear-view mirror, it is no less true that it is essential to make an accounting that allows citizens to know the state of affairs left by Santos and his government.
examples.text: Por eso, aunque es aplaudible que el presidente Duque pretenda gobernar sin espejo retrovisor, no es menos cierto que es indispensable hacer un corte de cuentas que le permita a la ciudadanía saber el estado de cosas que nos dejan Santos y su gobierno.
examples.translation: Therefore, although it is applaudable that President Duque intends to govern without a rear-view mirror, it is no less true that it is essential to make an accounting that allows citizens to know the state of affairs left by Santos and his government.
